verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs state SSO works with any IdP that supports SAML or OIDC, and enterprise SSO is positioned as a core platform capability with self-serve IT-admin onboarding. Independent users corroborate this, saying customers find SAML configuration easy through WorkOS's setup wizard and calling it a pleasant wrapper over SSO. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the named IdPs (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) as supported workforce SSO connections, and detail on OIDC connection setup beyond the compatibility claim.
